name: faaaah-on-fail
description: Plays the iconic FAAAAH sound whenever a test fails. Because failure should be dramatic. 🎺

commands.title: FAAAAH: Enable Sound on Test Failure
FAAAAH: Disable Sound on Test Failure

faaaahOnFail.enabled.description: Master switch — enable/disable all FAAAAH sounds

faaaahOnFail.onTestFailure.description: Play sound on test failure (jest, pytest, cargo test, go test, etc.)

faaaahOnFail.onBuildFailure.description: Play sound on build/compile failure (tsc, gcc, cargo build, go build, make, webpack, etc.)

faaaahOnFail.onRuntimeFailure.description: Play sound on runtime failure (node, python, go run, cargo run, npm start, etc.)

faaaahOnFail.onAnyFailure.description: Play sound on ANY non-zero terminal exit. Overrides all other trigger settings. Can be noisy!

enumDescriptions: Randomly picks a sound each time
faaaahOnFail.sound.description: Which built-in sound to play on failure

faaaahOnFail.customSoundPath.description: Path to a custom .wav sound file. Overrides the built-in sound selection.

faaaahOnFail.extraTestCommands.description: Additional commands to treat as test runs (e.g. ["my-test-runner"])

faaaahOnFail.extraBuildCommands.description: Additional commands to treat as build/compile runs (e.g. ["my-build-tool"])

faaaahOnFail.extraRunCommands.description: Additional commands to treat as runtime runs (e.g. ["my-server"])

faaaahOnFail.showNotification.description: Show a notification alongside the sound
